method: Independent price mathematics and Decimal cash arithmetic before any SRT/PTE outcome; no strategy decision output used as an oracle.
selection_rule: First completed opportunity with at least two intermediate hold signals; not selected by profit.
entry_cycle_assertion: Compare numeric Decimal fields and phase at every named checkpoint; remaining_budget is derived. cycle_id and opening_signal_identity are runtime identities, required constant within each scenario, not hardcoded.

formulae.center: median(log(eight unadjusted 30m closes)) + log(adjusted daily close / unadjusted daily close)
formulae.entry: center > center three sessions ago; adjusted close below center; exp(center-log(close))-1 >= fixed gap
formulae.exit: adjusted close reaches opening fixed center OR current center falls to opening center minus opening center_gain
formulae.budget: entry cash * signal allocation = 100000; lock until terminal exit, never reset on refill or hold
formulae.refill: min(locked target - actual shares, affordable lots from min(cash, budget-actual cumulative buy cost))
formulae.cash: initial cash - actual filled buy value - actual buy fees - outstanding buy reserves + realized sell proceeds - sell fees

limits: Historical authenticated inputs only. The strategy declares LAST=2026-10-21; this does not establish future-date deployability.
Each isolated technical account starts with100000; it is not a new economic backtest or independent validation sample.
Channel events are synthetic prescribed reports at historical in-range prices, not proof of actual liquidity or fills.
Recorded market-order inspection contract requires synchronous complete fills; partial SELL is not simulated.
All three public fault kinds are exercised on the first scenario. No production data/account/service is accessed.
Operator acknowledgement and subsequent retry are not expressible in the public inspection scenario contract and are not claimed.

revision.reason: The original scenario omitted required operator acknowledgement and incorrectly assumed automatic retry. Existing execution-gap policy requires BLOCKED after incomplete terminal cancellation.
revision.cancel_scope: Channel-originated partial cancellation without a local cancellation action or operator acknowledgement; no automatic retry is permitted.
revision.recovery_scope: Restart after partial fill; the subsequent cancellation must reconcile to the same blocked account as uninterrupted execution.
revision.not_covered: Operator acknowledgement and subsequent retry are not expressible in the public inspection scenario contract and are not claimed.
